response.overview: Former flight attendant Vera has waited her entire life for her one true love—an airline captain who never dared abandon his family for her. In her later years, she finds herself jobless, without family or friends, and with painful memories. Fearing sudden death, knowing that no one will be able to care for her, Vera decides to organize her own funeral in advance and invites a funeral director. He turns out to be a romantic young man. A love they never dared to share blossoms between them.…
response.title: Сладкое прощание Веры
